- $ n+1 = 24 = 2^3 \cdot 3 = 2^2 \cdot 6 $
- Square-free part is $ 6 $
- $ a_{23} = a_{6-1} = a_5 = 36 $

---

### **Conclusion**

The sequence is defined by the recurrence relation based on the square-free part of $ n+1 $. The recurrence is:

$$
\boxed{
a_n = 
\begin{cases}
(n+1)^2, & \text{if } n+1 \text{ is square-free} \\
a_{m-1}, & \text{where } m = \text{square-free part of } n+1
\end{cases}
}
$$
